observations: Photo 0 shows the side of an engine with an alternator, wiring harness, and an exhaust manifold heat shield featuring a logo.
Photo 1 shows the top of the engine with a black plastic intake manifold and a throttle body.
Photo 2 shows a silver engine cover with the Toyota logo and 'V6' embossed on it.
Handwritten text in green marker on the engine cover in photo 2 appears to read '2GR'.
A watermark 'NZ JAPANESE AUTOS' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The alternator is visible in photo 0, but the AC compressor, typically located lower on the block, is not clearly shown.
While the wiring harness and some accessories are visible, a full inventory of 'operators' (accessories) cannot be confirmed from these angles.
The 2GR-FE V6 engine shown is the standard V6 power plant for the Toyota models listed.
Static photos cannot prove mechanical operation or the absence of internal noise.
There is no odometer or service record visible to verify mileage.
Close-up photos of factory seals and head bolts are required to verify this.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (engine knock or sludge)
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine running or a borescope inspection of the cylinders.
A photo of the lower front of the engine block showing the compressor mounted.

risks.risk: Local used engine misrepresented as Tokunbo
risks.proof: Shipping documentation or port clearance papers.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running to confirm it is working and has no knock.
Photo of the AC compressor mounted on the engine block.
Close-up photos of the engine block stamps showing the model and serial number.
Close-up photos of the cylinder head bolts and gaskets to check for signs of being opened.
response.reason: The item is clearly a Toyota V6 engine, specifically a 2GR series based on the cover and components, which matches the seller's description for the listed vehicle models.
